title: hunch runbook capture includes Hunch's own auto-commits and .hunch/** files as steps
observation: `hunch runbook <range> --task` builds steps from rangeSubjects and files from rangeFiles with no filter, so every 'hunch: capture …' / 'hunch: capture test results' auto-commit becomes a runbook step and every .hunch/** record and generated grounding doc becomes a runbook file. sync already treats .hunch/** as circular (never synthesis input); runbook does not. Fix should be generic: exclude Hunch's own capture commits and store/grounding paths from runbook steps/files. Tracked as GitHub issue #425.
evidence: demo repo (git init + hunch init, auto-commit on): hunch runbook 3b53aed~1..HEAD --task "add a new auth rule" → rb_f0408d71d9 (12 steps, 29 files); 9 of 12 steps are 'hunch: …' commits; 23 of 29 files are Hunch-owned (18 under .hunch/**, plus AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules/hunch.mdc, .windsurf/rules/hunch.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md)
src/extractors/git.ts:2548-2557 rangeFiles/rangeSubjects: plain git log/diff, no filter
src/cli/index.ts ~1816 runbook command uses them directly
